app: In Atlassian Administration (admin.atlassian.com) select your organization, then Security > User security > Identity providers, pick your directory and choose Set up SAML single sign-on (needs Atlassian Guard; check your app's current UI).
Paste the three IdP details: Identity provider Entity ID = {idp_entity_id}, Identity provider SSO URL = {idp_sso_url}, and the public x509 certificate from {idp_cert_url}.

Atlassian then shows its 'Service provider entity URL' and 'Service provider assertion consumer service URL' - copy them exactly (including the ACS query string) into the FlareID service provider. They typically look like https://auth.atlassian.com/saml/{id} and https://auth.atlassian.com/login/callback?connection=saml-{id}.
Link the verified domains that should sign in through this directory, then save.
Test with a user whose Atlassian account email exactly matches their FlareID address - the NameID must be the email address, case included.
flareid: Add a SAML service provider (Admin > Applications > SAML service providers > New) and apply this template.
Replace the entity ID and ACS URL with the two values Atlassian shows after you save its side - each directory gets its own {id}.
Keep NameID format emailAddress; Atlassian rejects assertions whose NameID is not the account email.
No extra attributes are required for sign-in; display names sync through SCIM instead.
